messages.author: a9958963fada37ad
messages.subject: ddply hangs with 2 variables
parts:
Hi,

I have run into a strange issue with ddply. When running the following
Rscript:

#!/usr/bin/Rscript

library(plyr)

d = ddply(data.frame(a=1:101,b=1:101), .(a,b), nrow)
head(d)

the script does not terminate. It prints out head(d), but does not
return to the shell. By changing the a and b to 1:100, the script
returns. The same thing from within the R shell works fine. I'm using
plyr 1.5.2 and R 2.13.0 on ubuntu 11.04.

Can anyone else reproduce this?

Thanks,
Mikael

messages.author: a9958963fada37ad
messages.subject: Re: ddply hangs with 2 variables
parts:
If anyone else runs into the same thing, i've posted the same issue on
r-help and a workaround is to use littler.

Cheers,
Mikael
